veranderings.rede: 'vir 'n rede' calques English 'for a reason'; the Afrikaans idiom is 'met 'n rede'.

veranderings.voor: Koue kom nie by jou hand in nie.
veranderings.na: Koue kom nie in jou hand in nie.
veranderings.rede: 'by ... in' is an awkward preposition pair; 'in jou hand in' matches the earlier 'uit jou hand in die metaal in'.

veranderings.voor: trek yster en die meeste staal aan
veranderings.na: trek yster en die meeste soorte staal aan
veranderings.rede: 'die meeste soorte staal' reads more naturally for a mass noun and matches the next sentence's 'Party soorte vlekvrye staal'.

vlae.teks: Wanneer 'n dun laag 'n metaal mettertyd donker en dof maak.
vlae.rede: A definition opening with 'Wanneer' is a sentence fragment; a fuller form would need restructuring the definition, so it is left for the reviewer or writer rather than changed.

vlae.teks: Juwele: goud bly blink, en silwer word net dof.
vlae.rede: 'net' can read as 'only goes dull (does not rust)' or as 'simply goes dull'; the intended sense cannot be confirmed without guessing, so it is not changed.
